restaurant.name: Toriei
restaurant.tagline: Intimate 10-Seat Shio Yakitori Omakase in Orchard

chef.background: Chef-Owner Roy Koh and Head Chef Masashi Asai (formerly head chef at Bincho) bring over two decades of Japanese culinary devotion to Cuppage Plaza, focusing on whole-bird butchery, Kishu Binchotan fire, and minimalist shio seasoning.

hero.headline: A Ten-Seat Counter Dedicated to Binchotan Yakitori
hero.subline: Eighteen courses of French poulet, artisanal salt seasoning, and live charcoal embers on Cuppage Plaza Level 4.

intro.heading: Artisanal Yakitori Omakase in the Heart of Cuppage
paragraphs: Hidden away on the fourth floor of Cuppage Plaza, Toriei is a dedicated ten-seat yakitori counter celebrating the pure, unmasked flavors of French-breed chicken grilled over white Kishu Binchotan charcoal.

Unlike traditional yakitori seasoned with heavy, sweet tare glazes, Chef-Owner Roy Koh and Head Chef Masashi Asai present a focused shio (salt-led) omakase. Rare cuts are brined, skewered by hand, and seasoned only with mineral-rich Kochi and Okinawan sea salts.
With a single seating each evening, dining at Toriei is an unhurried, intimate ritual where guests watch every skewer turn over glowing coals from inches away.

feature.heading: Kishu Binchotan and Kochi Sea Salt Are Just The Start
feature.paragraph: Every skewer begins with whole GG French Poulet from Toh Thye San, broken down in-house daily. Each cut (including chicken oyster soriresu, crispy skin, and tender cartilage) is paired with precise heat zones on the grill, allowing the bird's natural sweetness and collagen to shine without compromise.

location.heading: Your Next Orchard Yakitori Destination

menu.description: Our nightly omakase transitions seamlessly from delicate starters into ten specialty chicken skewers, four seasonal vegetables, a comforting claypot rice soup, and dessert.

items.name: Collagen Chicken Chawanmushi
items.description: Silky steamed egg custard prepared exclusively with slow-simmered, concentrated chicken collagen broth and tender shredded meat.

items.name: Seasonal Otsumami
items.description: Chef's daily seasonal appetizer showcasing Japanese market ingredients to awaken the palate.

items.name: Soriresu (Chicken Oyster)
items.description: The prized nugget nestled in the thigh bone socket. Crisp charred skin concealing intensely juicy, tender dark meat.

items.name: Sasami (Tender Breast with Wasabi)
items.description: Delicate white meat gently kissed with charcoal heat, topped with freshly grated Shizuoka wasabi.

items.name: Kawa (Crisp Chicken Skin)
items.description: Slowly rendered over low embers until each fold turns paper-thin and shattering crisp.

items.name: Seseri (Chicken Neck)
items.description: Richly flavored meat from around the neck bone, offering remarkable chew and natural juices.

items.name: Sunagimo (Gizzard with Green Sansho)
items.description: Snap-crunch texture finished with a dusting of citrusy, tingling Japanese sansho pepper.

items.name: Hatsu (Chicken Heart)
items.description: Plump and sweet, grilled medium to retain tenderness and natural mineral sweetness.

items.name: Nankotsu (Cartilage)
items.description: Soft knee cartilage offering an addictive, crunchy bite seasoned with Kochi sea salt.

items.name: Tsukune (House Minced Meatball)
items.description: Hand-minced chicken thigh blended with minced cartilage for texture, roasted to golden perfection.

items.name: Bonjiri (Chicken Tail)
items.description: Crisp outer shell with rich, melting pockets of natural poultry fats.

items.name: Momo (Chicken Thigh & Charred Leek)
items.description: Juicy thigh cut skewered with sweet Japanese negi, charred until fragrant.

items.name: Ginnan (Japanese Ginkgo Nuts)
items.description: Tender, jade-green ginkgo nuts roasted in their shells with Kochi salt.

items.name: Shiitake Mushroom
items.description: Fleshy caps brushed with sake and grilled until the natural umami broth pools on top.

items.name: Sweet Hokkaido Corn
items.description: Golden kernel skewer lightly grilled over binchotan embers for sweet caramelization.

items.name: Shishito Pepper
items.description: Blistered sweet Japanese peppers with a mild smoky finish.

items.name: Claypot Tori Zosui
items.description: Comforting, slow-simmered rich chicken porridge with beaten Japanese egg, scallions, and roasted nori.

items.name: Sweet Potato Monaka Ice Cream
items.description: Crispy Japanese rice wafer sandwich filled with roasted sweet potato ice cream.

items.name: Curated Junmai Daiginjo
items.description: A rotating cellar selection of boutique Japanese sakes curated to complement shio yakitori.

items.name: Highballs & Craft Beers
items.description: Refreshing Japanese craft yuzu ales and ice-cold whisk(e)y highballs.
